additional_info.subject: ID0434548-DC/Si-D/DK-[MP / S3 170003389]Converter not found CRM:02681000416
additional_info.body:
Hi Rasmus,
For the converter error:
​​​​​​​
If the reboot doesn't work and the problem persists, we need to understand if it's a problem with the converter or the CAN cables.
For that, the easiest way it's always to swap this converter with the neighbour one (example, swap TB14 with TB15, everything - all cables and position)
If the converter with the error is still persisting, please replace the converter
If the working converter now has the CAN communication error, please check the CAN connection and see if the cables are properly attached and measure 60 Ohm between high and low.
Let me know if this is clear and I can send this ticket to you.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
